threads.body: so that the benchmarks wouldn't run for too long

[General] The fork inherits the agent's sampler configuration. For example, `OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on` makes the child sampled even though its parent is unsampled, so this measures a different span path and produces results that are not comparable with the intended unsampled case. Pin the fork to a parent-based sampler, or reject a sampled child during setup.

[Testing] With an inherited `OTEL_SDK_DISABLED=true`, span creation propagates the remote parent instead of creating a local child, so this benchmark can report misleading no-op timings. The diagnostic print does not reject that setup. Fail setup unless the child's span context is valid and local; this also works for the documented standalone-SDK baseline.
